operators.name: channel_shuffle_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: [N, C, H, W] with C divisible by groups

semantics: Given input x of shape (N, C, H, W), reshapes to (N, groups, C/groups, H, W), transposes dimensions 1 and 2, then reshapes to (N, C, H, W).
No arithmetic; output is a permutation of input channel slices along the channel dimension.
The operation preserves element order within each channel; only channel index mapping changes.
Input must be contiguous; output is allocated as tensor of same shape.
Input x is a contiguous CUDA float32 tensor of shape [32, 64, 512, 256].
Output is a tensor of identical shape, dtype, and device, with channels permuted according to groups=2.
No numerical computation; output values are identical to input values but with channel order swapped.
